WITH entertainer_styles AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, 
           MIN(CASE WHEN StyleStrength = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_style,
           MIN(CASE WHEN StyleStrength = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_style
    FROM Entertainer_Styles 
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT StyleStrength) >= 2
),
customer_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, 
           MIN(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
           MIN(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
    FROM Musical_Preferences 
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PreferenceSeq) >= 2
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM entertainer_styles es
JOIN customer_prefs cp ON 
    (es.first_style = cp.first_pref AND es.second_style = cp.second_pref)
    OR (es.first_style = cp.second_pref AND es.second_style = cp.first_pref)
JOIN Entertainers e ON es.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON cp.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
